Callout.Name: Debris in the Road
Callout.Message: Debris across two lanes, source unknown.
Callout.Advisory: No vehicles stopped nearby, several near misses.

Script.Line: It is across both lanes and nobody knows where it came from.
It is metal. Something has come off something.
People are swerving at the last second. It is going to happen.

Lines.Approach: Nobody knows where it came from and three people have nearly hit it. Somebody has to stand there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
